Action.name: MURDER_HOTKEY
Action.Down: if GetSetting(SETTING_TYPE_COMBAT, COMBAT_SETTING_PREVENT_ATTACKING_INNOCENTS) == "1" then SetSetting(SETTING_TYPE_COMBAT, COMBAT_SETTING_PREVENT_ATTACKING_INNOCENTS, 0) d("Innocents may now be murdered") else SetSetting(SETTING_TYPE_COMBAT, COMBAT_SETTING_PREVENT_ATTACKING_INNOCENTS, 1) d("You may no longer commit wanton murder") end
